name: canteen-counter
description: Visual Tap Register for John Cen's Kitchenette — two-tap checkout with a local SQLite ledger.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
